agents.name: hunav_1
agents.role: Visitor walking along the waiting aisle
agents.behavior: Start facing along the aisle toward the first waypoint and walk nearly straight toward the opposite waiting seats, ahead of the following robot.

robot.name: robot
robot.behavior: Start approximately 1.5 meters behind the pedestrian and follow the same aisle trajectory in the same direction, ending at the pedestrian's penultimate waypoint without overtaking.
